data.body: DEFENSE_RECORD: {"finding_id": "f-b2c3d4e5", "defense_text": "The bash 'if grep ... ; then assert_eq ... ; fi' pattern is defensive: it only fires the assertion when the regression IS present. The negative path is implicitly covered by the positive assertions (assert_contains for the correct title). The new test_defer_title_falls_back_on_empty_slug uses the same defensive idiom plus a strict positive grep -F assertion.", "severity_history": [{"cycle": 1, "severity": "important"}]}
